evidence: Analysis ran as a Hopsworks Python job (leakage_analysis) over the CSV uploaded to /Resources/leakage. f6 alone achieves ROC AUC = 1.000 against the label with Pearson correlation 0.993 and a class-mean separation of 17.4 pooled standard deviations — perfect separation, indicating it was computed from post-outcome data. All other features are weak, plausible predictors: single-feature AUCs of 0.532-0.595 and correlations of 0.061-0.160 (f1=0.545, f2=0.595, f3=0.537, f4=0.532, f5=0.552). Full per-feature results are stored on the platform at /Resources/leakage/leakage_analysis.json.
